reviews.title: Stop Changing My Ovulation Date
reviews.text:
Really frustrating that the app changes the date of my ovulation depending on when my period starts because of antiquated understanding that the luteal phase must be a certain length. Let the data speak for itself, do not change the data to fit a narrative.

Also very misleading in that the app makes you believe you can track ovulation with temperature alone. You also need to be tracking at least cervical fluid or cervical position as well. There have been times when it says I’m not fertile but I still have very clear ovulatory cervical fluid indicating otherwise. Do better.

reviews.title: Great app!
reviews.text: I’ve really been enjoying using Natural Cycles and it’s such a great level of reassurance. I feel like one thing that would make the app better is if it gave us personal insights on things to do more or less of on our period. Foods that can help us in different cycles and recommended exercises and routines to help get in tune with our body!

reviews.title: Amazing!
reviews.text: Amazing and accurate. I use my Oura Ring to track. So happy I went with this app.

reviews.title: It logged me off.
reviews.text: I paid for a year subscription in June. The app logged me off. I logged back in and it wants me to pay for a new subscription, it’s acting like I’m a new member. It’s only been 3 out of the 12 months for this subscription. The team is slow at responding. They figured out I didn’t use a real email when I originally created an account because I had a typo in my email.

reviews.title: Frustrating
reviews.text: I bought the clear blue kit for NC, and nothing connected to the app. It wouldn’t let me continue without an Apple Watch, but of course my Apple Watch doesn’t have body temperature. Very frustrating there was no way to manually enter my basal body temp with the thermometer and kit I BOUGHT, and to keep being pushed to buy something more.

reviews.title: Will not refund.
reviews.text: Please note refund policy! The company will not refund the $150 yearly subscription.

reviews.title: Quality seems less than before
reviews.text: I’m wondering if anyone else has noticed that the algorithm is not predicting or following the data the way it used to. I have used this app for 3+ years and really enjoy it, but I’m assuming that they have begun using AI more than they previously were because it is suddenly giving me far more red days even though I am very regular and track a lot. This app helped me learn to track my symptoms so well in the beginning to the point that I can pretty much tell where I’m at on my own now. It seems more and more common for the app to tell me things that I know are just flat wrong based on how i feel, or that my period is coming 7 days earlier than normal for no reason, and then it comes right when it always does. I used to be shocked at how spot on it was. Now I’m not so sure. Nothing on my end has changed, so something “under the hood” (as they like to refer to in their update summaries) has changed. Not sure I want to keep paying.

reviews.title: Unexpected $162 Charge and No Response from Customer Service
reviews.text:
Very disappointed with Natural Cycles. I was charged $161.99 for a subscription renewal without any clear warning or notification. I had understood that my Oura offer included a year of access, so this charge was completely unexpected.

I reached out to customer service about the charge and never received a response. I also found that Flo provides very similar fertility-tracking information without the same expensive subscription.

Charging $162 without a clear renewal reminder and then not responding to a customer’s request for help is extremely frustrating. I would not recommend this app based on my experience.

reviews.title: Scammers
reviews.text: Beware, this company will charge you before your subscription is due or even if you have already canceled your subscription. Best part is once you request a refund they refuse!

reviews.title: Helpful
reviews.text:
I enjoy the science, learning, and research put into this app. Especially because it is personalized to me. It isn’t like period apps that give you horoscopes generalized to groups. 

I think it could be improved for inputting pregnancies. Especially miscarriages. But all the same I appreciate how it tracks my cycle.

reviews.title: Loving NC
reviews.text: NC has been amazing to track my cycle, ovulation, etc. it has helped me to better understand my body and I hope and pray will be a contributor to pregnancy!

reviews.title: 50 steps then pay
reviews.text: This app will ask you to provide a lot of data and then 50 steps down the road they want $100 without even letting you to see how this app looks or works.

reviews.title: Too expensive and customer service is terrible
reviews.text: Overcharge for their service and the customer service team isn’t helpful.

reviews.title: Paid Subscription
reviews.text: Go through a whole process of signing up for the app (which takes like 2-3 minutes) only to get hit with a paid subscription. That is my biggest pet peeve. There should be a disclaimer that this is NOT a free app so that people who don’t want to pay for a subscription don’t waste their time with it. You have the option of an annual plan for $149 or a monthly plan for $22??? Like what? Why is everything a subscription nowadays?? Ridiculous. It’s getting the point where every app you download expects you to pay a monthly subscription. I’m not paying $149 for an app I don’t even know if I’d like??  Why isn’t there a free version? Or at least a free trial?? Ridiculous.

reviews.title: Helpful app
reviews.text: I enjoyed using this app to track. Easy to use

reviews.title: Took a few months but it’s so worth it
reviews.text: I have hypothyroidism and hashimotos, I’ve never been the most regular but using this app has been my BEST way of understanding my body and figure out patterns.

reviews.title: Got pregnant the first cycle using the app!
reviews.text: This app is great for showing my fertile days, I got pregnant my first cycle using this app along with my Oura ring.

reviews.title: Recent updates have made app glitchy
reviews.text: This is the best hormone free birth control/app. I’ve been using for years. The past app updates have made the app more glitchy and less user friendly. Not sure what’s going on with user experience over there

reviews.title: Great flexibility with almost too many options
reviews.text: This app has a ton of flexibility to allow for tracking the panopoly of variable lifestyle factors and physical/mental observations that can go into fertility tracking. There are also personalized analytic “insights” and general relevant educational nuggets, plus further self-guided learning. The basic fertility charts are great and similarly enhanced with associated value-added features. It’s a great app if you want a really comprehensive fertility experience. The one fault could be that it can feel overwhelming, with so much going on in one place.

reviews.title: Have to pay
reviews.text: Can’t use without paying

reviews.title: Simple and informative
reviews.text: I love how easy it is to use and brings me peace of mind. My primary use for it is to prevent pregnancy. I love that I don’t have to use hormonal birth control, I took hormonal birth control for 14 years and I finally feel like myself again! Thank you Natural Cycles!

reviews.title: Watch out for hidden fees
reviews.text: Charges you a ridiculous yearly fee and sends you a non de script email assuming you won’t cancel in time. No refunds in their cancellation policy is how they trap you.

reviews.title: Sneaky and Dishonest
reviews.text: I had the free trial of this app when I purchased my Oura ring. I guess when I created a profile it connected to my apple ID, therefor when they sent out the “reminder” email I never received it. How was I supposed to know this? These kinds of practices are deceptive and sneaky, a way for them to get their $150 and i had no clue. Mind you, i’ve only had access to the “demo” version of the app despite them taking $150 of my hard earned dollars as well. I am extremely upset and now I will not be able to afford this months bills. But I am glad Natural Cycles got their $150.

reviews.title: I wish that you weren’t using AI.
reviews.text: I love this app and I like using it, it’s a very simple way of preventing pregnancy and knowing my cycle and how everything is affected with it. My only issue is the use generative AI in the app. I feel as though, if this is made by genuine professionals, why would you need a something like AI to give information FOR you? And with knowing that it can give false information. I also feel as though, if I’m paying to have the information about my body and about my cycle, then I would want that information to given by other PEOPLE who have that same EXPERIENCE. You can’t learn anything about the body from something that doesn’t have a soul. Please, get rid of it.

reviews.title: Good except…
reviews.text: Please make the AI optional. I’m really not a fan of generative AI and I really dislike that I am not given the option to opt out of it. The app also feels a little non-intuitive with finding information. Besides this, I have been using this for a couple of years now and find it helpful to track my cycle.

reviews.title: Love it!
reviews.text: Coming up on a year of using natural cycles. Love the app. It’s been very very accurate for me. I use my Apple Watch and testing strips when the app suggests. It’s crazy how spot on it has been for me. My husband also finds the partner app helpful, he says it helps him know when he needs to be more careful and when my moods may be different. All around, love it!

reviews.title: Natural Choices
reviews.text: Natural Cycle has been an amazing option in place of birth control pills. I’m so glad I found them, I only wish I had found this sooner. I love that I can watch my cycle while actively preventing pregnancy without the side effects of birth control pills and adding extra hormones that are not naturally in my body.

reviews.title: Best app ever
reviews.text: Switched to this from nexplanon and soooo thankful I did. I can’t believe I was taking essentially poison every day of the month for 6 days I needed to be careful. Works great with the oura ring. All my side effects from nexplanon are gone and I have never been more informed about my body in my life.

reviews.title: Love the wristband!
reviews.text: I wanted to get off of hormonal birth control and started tracking my cycle instead. I didn’t want to wear a piece of jewelry all the time like the oura ring or Apple Watch just to help track my cycle, so when NC introduced with wristband it was exactly what I was looking for! The wristband along with NC has made tracking my cycle SO EASY!! The NC app does a really good job at educating you about your cycle too which has been so helpful. I’m 33 and have never been so in tune with my cycle thanks to NC.

reviews.title: never looking back
reviews.text:
i am so happy with natural cycles. i don’t see myself going back to hormonal birth control every again. i was on homornal birth control from a very young age g age into adulthood. it took a toll on my
boys from no sex drive to flat lined hormones & depression. i’m grateful because i won’t try for kids for a couple years yet (in my mid 30s) and tracking with natural cycles i’m hopeful when the time comes it’ll be easier to conceive as well. it’s reliable and natural. so happy.

reviews.title: NC + Oura
reviews.text: The app feels outdated. You have to manually log oura data into NC. Some features are hard to understand. Way overpriced

reviews.title: Downhill the past year-about to discontinue use after 5 years
reviews.text:
UPDATE: The app now relies heavily on ovulation tests to “predict” ovulation. Logging ovulation tests changes green and red days. This is extremely problematic and adds another opportunity for user error for an app that is supposed to be relying on an algorithm based on basal body temperature. Your customer support is non responsive and your development team obviously does NOT take these reviews or submitted suggestions for improvements into consideration despite your copy and paste replies or else we would have seen the changes we’ve asked for by now. The company does not value women’s health- only their bottom line. $159 a year for what? Profits over people. 
Also, stop shoving AI down our throats. 
Previous review: 
Please update to be able to clearly see cycle day when clicking on future dates on the calendar like we used to see. 
The 2 stars is because recent updates to the app have made it LESS user friendly. More buttons to do the same thing we used to do with fewer buttons. Also the yearly subscription price is astronomical- I have been using this app for almost 5 years and it’s just getting out of control with the pricing. I’ve not seen added value. 
Being able to tap to focus during the ovulation test reader would be a long awaited and much needed improvement.

reviews.title: Not Enough Info Up Front
reviews.text: I bought this app, thinking I had a compatible garmin device to use with it. By the time I figured out only certain models work and mine isn’t one, I had already paid for the monthly subscription. I’m not going to spend $200+ on a new device on top of the price of the app. It’s just not worth it, I’m not that far into trying/tracking yet. It’s upsetting that I didn’t even use the app at all, and I got charged the full fee—imagine if I had gone ahead and paid for the year up front!! Feels gross to me.

reviews.title: Great
reviews.text: Works great for tracking everything I wish they had a few extra symptom and other things but it’s amazing

reviews.title: Pointless and inaccurate
reviews.text: Have been using this app along with oura ring for temp tracking. I have regular periods and after 6 months of use it still tells me every day is a ‘use protection’/‘red’ day, except during the days I’m actually on my period. And my periods are regular, which tells me their algorithm for prediction is just awful.

reviews.title: Not for night shift workers
reviews.text: The NC compatible wearables only use data taken from 7p-10am. NC states you only need 4 hours of sleep which isn’t accurate, after speaking to customer support you’ll find out you need 4 hours of sleep within 7p-10am. If you get home from work at 7am like I do your data wont be taken even if sleeping 8 hours straight. This information needs to be stated up front so shift workers don’t waste their money or time trying to get data to appear.

reviews.title: They actually care
reviews.text: I had a miscarriage while using the app to track the pregnancy (any my cycles previously). One of the hardest things was to log the end of the pregnancy with all of my apps like Oura ring, pregnancy tracker apps etc. Natural Cycles has sent countless messages validating the grieving process and hormonal changes, sending articles to read and mental health check ins. You can tell this app was designed by women. They’ve been more helpful and caring than my OB. I am grateful this app not only practices the medical side of women’s needs but also the emotional. Worth every penny.

reviews.title: Partner view
reviews.text: Update the partner view. Add more versatility to the app and more features. And give me a dark mode please.

reviews.title: App is good but they are going woke.
reviews.text: Pretty good app for us better than any hormone drug or device but me and my wife don't like how woke they are getting. Not as friendly if you want to have baby and they're starting to use the terms “people who menstruate” versus “women”. Which this app is entirely for women not mutilated men.

reviews.title: What's the point?
reviews.text: I got a free 28 day trial, so I decided to try it. However, I can't even add any data because I'm in "demo mode" so it shows me fake data. What's the point in the free trial if I can't even use it? Also I want to stay on my hormonal birth control, since it's more effective than the app, I just wanted to use the app to track my periods but I can't even add the days I have my periods. It's pretty frustrating and I don't even see the point in having it.

reviews.title: Happy Cycler!
reviews.text: This app has given me much peace of mind with my intimate life. I gifted this to myself for my 23rd birthday and I couldn’t be happier with it! My partner and I love to have it :)

reviews.title: Scam
reviews.text:
I downloaded this so I could track my temp throughout the day so I can track my fertility but you need to buy a subscription just to use the damn app, there’s other apps out there that could do the same thing but free! This app is a money hungry scam demanding money off of women wanting to know more about their bodies.
Edit cause I’m mad about this: So first of all you want to protect our data but put a price tag on it? You should want to protect it without us paying. Also when did I mention birth control, cause I didn’t, I wanted to be able to track my temperature with my Apple Watch throughout the day so I can track my cycle more accurately. I can understand having a subscription to obtain more information and have other stuff in the app like Flo and other period tracker apps do but having a free to download app but I have to pay in the app to even use it seems scummy. The developer that responded to me really didn’t respond to my review and seemed to just copy and paste a response in just to make me “happy” which pisses me off more. If you’re constantly getting negative reviews for the same thing, it really tells you something that the developers should fix. Respectfully do better.

reviews.title: Sketchy Refund Policy
reviews.text: I checked out this app through an Oura ring trial that I was provided. I tried this out and didn’t care for needing to track my cycle on three different applications. I much prefer using Stardust and Oura. I did not remember how long the trial was for, and forgot to cancel in time and was unexpectedly charged the $149.99 fee. With how expensive living is right now it comes at a huge inconvenience to me and my family as school is starting soon and those funds would’ve been useful for my child’s school supplies instead of an app I won’t be using. Contacted customer service and they are so anal about the fact that they sent a courtesy reminder and since I didn’t cancel at that point that I just have to eat the cost. Don’t even try them there are better apps out there.

reviews.title: Hate this App, now I’m stuck with it for another year
reviews.text: Hate this app and now I’m stuck for it for another year. Tried for pregnancy for a year and wasn’t helpful at all. From the ovulation tracking to the period tracking, didn’t do anything more than the oura app. If anything it was more inaccurate. An app is suppose to simplify one’s life, not complicate it. So with the app and service and 100% not satisfied with outcome. Frustrated by this app.

reviews.title: More to come
reviews.text: Only reason for the 4 star is I’m still unlocking the benefits of Natural Cycles and my Oura ring. So far I have loved that NC encourages me to check in daily and takes into consideration the average woman during their cycle; but combines average with my own unique normalcy. Looking forward to seeing results months down the road.

reviews.title: Incorrect ovulation calculations
reviews.text: My husband and I have been TTC and I will say that at first I was fully trusting the app and the algorithm. As time went on, it seemed to drastically change the date. I started testing for LH on day 6 of my cycle through day 15 to find the peak and the app consistently has ovulation days behind the LH testing. The wrist temp is can be altered if you wake up before your normal time, and it’s now excluding data on its own accord and not allowing me to override it.

reviews.title: Natural Cycles Review
reviews.text: Love this app! It’s so helpful for my husband and I. Totally worth it!

reviews.title: Scummy Business Practices
reviews.text: SUPER scummy business practices, you get one very discrete email reminding you about your $150 subscription payment- then they REFUSE a refund even if you cancel and request it within the hour it was charged, even if you’re pregnant and no longer using the app. There are other apps that track your cycle just as well- pick one that’s not in the business of screwing over new moms.

reviews.title: Accurate information
reviews.text: The app is great at tracking everything, and I feel confident that it’s giving me accurate information every month. Will continue to use.

reviews.title: Have to pay for this.
reviews.text: I just got an Oura ring and wanted to sync my cycle up with it but you have to pay $20 a month for this app. Absolutely crazy.
